ibans.title: IBANs to check
ibans.description: One per line. Spaces and dashes are ignored, so you can paste them exactly as your bank prints them. Up to 10,000 per run.

text.title: Or paste a document (optional)
text.description: Used only when 'IBANs to check' is empty: IBANs are pulled out of an invoice, an email or any pasted text, in the order they appear.

bics.title: BICs (optional, same order as the IBANs)
bics.description: 8 or 11 characters, one per line. We prove one thing about them: the country inside the BIC must match the IBAN. We do not claim to know the account's bank.
